data.title: IBM software sourcing review exposes schedule gap

actions.description: CP/M-86 does not exist. DRI prioritises CP/M-80/TUI, AIONix and PRO. Adam owns 30% of independent DRI and Logix competes with IBM, making schedule and strategic dependence concerns substantial. Paterson never creates QDOS; Microsoft cannot acquire the historical SCP product. IBM investigates independently commissioned disk-OS alternatives.
